headline: Let the necessary truth reshape the agreement
summary: The Sun’s exact meeting with your natal Pluto asks for a clean encounter with power: where are you accommodating a story, agreement, or identity that no longer matches what you know is true? This is not a call to force a dramatic change. It is an invitation to name the real responsibility and let that honesty reorganize your choices. Mars flowing with your natal Neptune gives compassion and imagination to the work, but it also asks you to separate a meaningful next step from a beautiful fantasy. Venus and Mercury open a more graceful conversation later in the day; use it to say what you value, not to make a promise before you feel settled.

Your Human Design transits sharpen the same lesson around authority and exchange. Saturn in Gate 21 completes the Money Line, putting stewardship, boundaries, and fair agreements in focus. The Moon in Gate 51 can bring a jolt of courage or a desire to prove yourself; let it wake you up without letting it choose for you. Mercury in Gate 64 is still gathering the pieces into a pattern, while Pluto on your natal Gate 41 can make the pressure to begin feel urgent. The Sun on your natal Gate 40 reminds you that willpower works best when rest and reciprocity are part of the agreement. As a 3/5 Emotional Projector, wait for the right invitation, then give your emotional wave time to clarify what is truly yours to carry.
focus: Choose the agreement that preserves your power; let emotional clarity, not the first jolt, decide the next move.
